training_device: CPU for all originally started tasks; five previously unstarted high-dimensional long tasks use MPS, as fixed in protocol.train_device_overrides.
evaluation_devices: CPU for small tasks and M4; MPS for larger batches; recorded per result (early M4 records use CPU).

numerical_correction.reason: All gradient elements finite, FP32 L2 norm overflow; recompute norm in FP64 before clipping. Real nonfinite gradients still terminate.
numerical_correction.resume: Exact RNG/optimizer checkpoint at step 57; no task or batch skipped.

additional_regression_fix: Zero-variance advancing-frame standard deviation has unchanged forward values and a finite derivative on the scale floor.

inference_device_probe.source: 64 electricity/15T official training prefixes only, last 24576 samples, H48, base 5M

interrupted_cpu_evaluation: An incomplete electricity/15T/short CPU pass was discarded before an atomic metric record was written; rerun on MPS.
hyperparameter_policy: Seed, sampling, objective, learning rate, step budget and checkpoint criterion fixed before test evaluation; no tuning against test metrics.

runtime_thread_policy.purpose: Avoid spin-wait overhead across independent local processes; no sampling or optimization hyperparameter changes.

parallel_execution: Four independent CPU training processes, per-task advisory file locks; atomic result files. CPU/MPS evaluation workers claim independent task/kind jobs.

metric_optimization.change: Replace contiguous np.take(range(...)) with equivalent slices; no history truncation, masking or reduction changes.
metric_optimization.parity: seasonal_metric_parity.json (four tasks, all eleven metrics bitwise equal)

mps_norm_boundary: The overflow regression also runs on MPS: copy gradients to CPU before FP64 conversion, avoiding the unsupported fused device/dtype copy.

hardware_selection.rule: At least 20 target+past-covariate rows, horizon >=480, and no existing formal checkpoint at selection time.
hardware_selection.selection_data: official training prefixes only; runtime and input dimensions, never validation/test scores
hardware_selection.adapter_initialization: same CPU-seeded initialization on both backends
